name: No Time For Pants
detailed_description:
You wake in a mysterious facility and quickly realize you are not alone. The facility's artificial intelligence has taken over and the result is horrific. Find what you need to escape and survive as long as you can. Unlock new weapons, gear, and attachments as you delve deeper into the facility, battling your way to freedom.  You sense your humanity slipping away as you become the monster you need to be to escape... If you were ever human at all.

Core Loop

Single Player Roguelite - You lose what you have on you when you die.  Your currency, mission progress, as well as any implants your character has will persist to the next run.

Extraction Pressure - Loot each area for what you need - medbay (first aid), offices (silicon scrap for implants), security (weapons). Gunfire raises alert levels and draws enemies. Battle your own greed as you escape with everything you can.

Systems that Matter

Drag and drop inventory management - Modify your gear and loadout on the fly depending on your situation.  Smoke will quickly drain your stamina and poison gas is deadly. A gas mask will protect you from both but it will decrease your stamina regeneration rate if you get caught trying to sprint or are over encumbered.

Meaningful Attachments -  Flashlights speed up searching but attract unseen threats. First-aid pouches boost healing speed. Lasers improve aim and raise crit chance. Other mods speed reloads, power up energy weapons, and more.

Noise and Alert -  Weapons make noise; noise raises alert; higher alert means more enemies- but better loot. Suppressors buy you time to loot before things spiral.

Player Modification - Implants are upgrades that persist your entire run - move faster, carry more, heal quicker, search faster. Implants require power; run out and they drain your health instead.

Gunplay First -  Feel like a badass—even in your underpants. Precise aiming reduces spread and elevates crit chance. Kit rifles with flashlights, suppressors, scopes, and lasers to build your ideal tool. Energy-weapon mods cut heat, boost damage, and raise rate of fire.

short_description: Compact, tactical, rogue-lite, 2d extraction with pixelized graphics and a dark, gritty tone.  Gather all the resources you can and customize your loadout- you must evolve with every death to fight through the horrors that await you. This is No Time For Pants!
